description: Leases are now based on architectural layers and contracts, with dependency-aware overlap checks.

accepted.by: gary (in conversation, 2026-11-23: "accept the specs"; recorded by the implementing agent)

specs.description: A lease on a layer slice resolves to the files in that slice.
specs.given: A hexagonal project with a layer 'usecases/billing' containing files A, B, C.
specs.when: A user runs `hexa agent register --task t1 --lease usecases/billing`.
specs.then: The lease is granted for files A, B, C.

specs.description: A lease on a non-existent layer slice is refused.
specs.given: A hexagonal project with no layer 'usecases/nonexistent'.
specs.when: A user runs `hexa agent register --task t1 --lease usecases/nonexistent`.
specs.then: The lease is refused with an error.

specs.description: A contract lease is refused if its files are used by another live lease.
specs.given: A live lease on 'usecases/billing' that uses 'ports/billing.rs'.
specs.when: A user runs `hexa agent register --task t2 --lease ports/billing.rs`.
specs.then: The lease is refused, and the refusal names 'usecases/billing' as the consumer.

specs.description: A contract lease is granted if its files are not used by any live lease.
specs.given: No live leases in the project.
specs.when: A user runs `hexa agent register --task t1 --lease ports/billing.rs`.
specs.then: The lease is granted.

specs.description: An edit to a frozen contract file is refused.
specs.given: A live lease on 'usecases/billing' that freezes 'ports/billing.rs'.
specs.when: A user in another session edits 'ports/billing.rs'.
specs.then: The edit is refused by the hook with exit code 2, naming the lease that froze the file

specs.description: An edit to a non-frozen contract file is allowed.
specs.given: No live leases in the project.
specs.when: A user edits 'ports/billing.rs'.
specs.then: The edit is allowed.

specs.description: Merge order sorts tasks by layer.
specs.given: Finished tasks: 'domain/task1', 'ports/task2', 'usecases/task3', 'adapters/task4'.
specs.when: A user runs `hexa dev worktree merge-order`.
specs.then: The tasks are merged in the order: 'domain/task1', 'ports/task2', 'usecases/task3', 'adapters/task4'.

specs.description: Finishing first does not merge first
specs.given: Two finished tasks: one leasing `usecases/` that finished first, one leasing `domain/` that finished later
specs.when: A user runs `hexa dev worktree merge-order`.
specs.then: The order printed puts the `domain/` task before the `usecases/` task, and says the later task must rebase and re-pass its gate

specs.description: Hot shared files are leased for a single gated edit.
specs.given: A file 'mod.rs' that is shared across layers.
specs.when: A user runs `hexa do gate` to edit 'mod.rs'.
specs.then: The lease is granted for the duration of the gated edit.

specs.description: Hot shared files cannot be leased for a whole task.
specs.given: A file 'mod.rs' that is shared across layers.
specs.when: A user runs `hexa agent register --task t1 --lease mod.rs`.
specs.then: The lease is refused.

specs.description: An unbound edit is refused when a second live session is detected.
specs.given: Two live sessions in the same repository.
specs.when: A user in an unbound session attempts to edit a file.
specs.then: The edit is refused, and the user is instructed to register.

specs.description: An unbound edit is allowed when there is only one live session.
specs.given: One live session in the repository.
specs.when: A user in an unbound session attempts to edit a file.
specs.then: The edit is allowed.

specs.description: Two leased tasks, two worktrees, one ledger
specs.given: Two tasks registered from two worktrees of one repository
specs.when: `hexa agent list` runs in each worktree
specs.then: Each task records its own worktree, and both worktrees list the same two tasks

specs.description: A contract lease is refused exactly when a live lease consumes it
specs.given: Any set of live leases and a new lease on files under `ports/` or `domain/`
specs.when: `hexa agent register` is called after `hexa graph build`
specs.then: It is refused, naming the consuming lease, exactly when some file it covers is consumed by code under another live lease whose contract is not explicitly frozen for it; otherwise it is granted

specs.description: Another lease never edits a frozen file
specs.given: Any live use-case or adapter lease and the port and domain files the graph says it depends on
specs.when: Any other lease edits one of those files
specs.then: The hook refuses the edit; and two adapter leases never refuse each other through dependency

specs.description: Merge order is layer order
specs.given: Any set of finished tasks in any finishing order
specs.when: `hexa dev worktree merge-order` runs
specs.then: Tasks are ordered domain, ports, use cases, adapters, composition root; within a layer, by finished time

specs.description: A hot shared file is never leased for a whole task
specs.given: Any composition root, `mod.rs`, `lib.rs`, manifest or lockfile
specs.when: A task registers a lease naming it
specs.then: The task lease is refused; that file is held only for the length of one `hexa do gate` edit and is free again when it ends

specs.description: An unbound edit is refused exactly when another session is live
specs.given: Any repository with any number of live sessions and an edit from a session bound to no task
specs.when: The edit hook runs
specs.then: The edit is refused with the command to register exactly when a second live session exists; a lone session is never asked

specs.description: A second worktree never has a ledger of its own
specs.given: A task in worktree A leasing `usecases/billing`
specs.when: From worktree B, a task registers a lease on `usecases/billing`
specs.then: The registration is refused naming A's task, because B reads the same ledger as A

specs.description: Every worktree sees one ledger
specs.given: Any number of worktrees of one repository
specs.when: Tasks are registered and listed from any of them
specs.then: Every worktree reads and writes the ledger in the main checkout's `.hexa/`, and each leased task names its own worktree
